In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] served as the '''boss''' of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Golden Storm]]. She oversaw the kidnapping and [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the gang's [[Golden Storm's hideout|hideout]].<ref name="EO" />
